text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, my liege.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I, Durandalâ have arrived with the 
rising sun.

While they were in their racing silks, 
here I was in a jersey, scratching my head 
awkwardly as I greeted them...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono. That attire... As a King, 
does it not lack a certain crispness?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Keep your back straight! Look sharp! And 
give us a sparkling smile! If you please.

Right at the start of the New Year, my 
etiquette got thoroughly called out...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My King. Without further ado, let us begin 
the war council in preparation for this 
year.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
First, let's look at the other camps' 
movements.

Let's check in on the Classic-class 
Umamusume of the same generation, as well 
as the Senior-class Umamusume who are one 
step ahead.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
First, our contemporaries. Following Fine 
Motion-san and Symboli Kris S-san, who 
have already claimed victories...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Tanino Gimlet-san and No Reason-san have 
also claimed victory. But..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It seems no one is heading for the sprint 
division. They shouldn't pose any threat 
to us.

Among the Senior Class who have already 
debuted, there are formidable sprint 
Umamusume. The one to watch out for in 
particular is...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
First is Believe. Both in running and 
personality, she's an utterly steady and 
dependable Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Her greatest strength is her "endurance," 
never completely falling apart. Lately, 
she's been getting stronger by leaps and 
bounds.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Next up is Calstone Light O. Her greatest 
strength is her obsession with absolute 
"top speed."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
In terms of instantaneous top speed, 
probably no one can match her. On the flip 
side, she has zero stamina for distance.

Believe and Calstone Light O. The 
successes of these two were beginning to 
stand out somewhat.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Believe-san and Light O-san are in my 
year and my class. And what's more, Light 
O-san is..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
She shares a room with me in the dorm, 
too. Precisely because the two of them are 
so close...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—I cannot lose. I will never settle for 
trailing in another's dust.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Lord Trainer, in pursuit of 
victory, let us write our New Year's 
calligraphy.

And so, after changing clothes and heading 
to the calligraphy venue—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah, Durandal! Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
How is your progress since then? Have you 
been reading the textbook on elegance that 
I gave you as a present?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I look through them day and night. If 
you'd like to do the first calligraphy of 
the year, let us do it together.

I exchanged New Year's greetings with Fine 
Motion, who happened to be there, and we 
did our first calligraphy of the year 
together.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I finished writing! My resolution is...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Have fun!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This is definitely the way to go. Filled 
with gratitude to everyone who allowed me 
to race while studying abroad♪

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"My King. Please accept this brush stroke 
of my oath."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: What I shall write down is, of course—!
(Rrrrriiiip!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No, you're wrong! That's just the sound of 
me tearing the paper by accident from 
pressing too hard...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I was trying to write 'Dignity'... Uuu... 
What a blunder..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I can master it just by 
reading... What should I do to become a 
dignified knight...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Just reading books isn't enough, huh. Hmm, 
in that case...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Durandal. Why don't we try competing 
in something?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: A challenge...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The theme is: maintain our dignity 
and claim an elegant victory!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Oho, a contest of elegance! In that case, 
by all means!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you for accepting♪ After all, 
times like New Year's are the only chance 
I get to make time for knightly training.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer, make your choice. What 
kind of contest do you want to see between 
Durandal and me?

A contest while maintaining dignity and 
grace. What I'd like them to do is...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wrestling... I don't really have much 
experience with it, but... Yeah! I think 
I'd like to give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Unarmed grappling techniques, I see. I 
would be honored to spar with you.
(Tweet!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Come to me, Durandal!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ――Here goes!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(My liege is watching... I cannot allow 
myself to look unsightly.)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Waiting patiently is an option. However, 
right now... the first strike wins!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufun, saw right through you♪ Hah!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Urgh, hook, line, and sinker...!

Durandal's charging movement was easily 
read, and she was soundly defeated by Fine 
Motion.

And so, after spending New Year's Day with 
Fine Motion—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Selfies... Are you challenging me to see 
which of us can take a more elegant 
self-portrait?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds interesting. Then let us have a 
leisurely competition."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Well then, I shall take my leave.
(Flash!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the meal. I'd say it was 
just alright—neither good nor bad.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, that natural elegance, even when just 
being herself... She really is in a league 
of her own... But still...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(I cannot lose...! I refuse to show such a 
pathetic display before Trainer-dono...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...! Like this!
(Flash!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it just feels like it's lacking a 
certain punch...

An effortless grace. In that regard, it 
seemed Durandal was still no match for 
Fine Motion.

And so, after spending New Year's Day with 
Fine Motion—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Picking out clothes? Oh, my. Then would 
you be so kind as to escort me to the 
department store?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Fashion sense... I don't know if I can 
compete with royalty, but... I have to 
try.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This, this... and then that plain white 
T-shirt over there, please.

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: I'd also recommend this pattern, though?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, but that tartan belongs to a 
clan of a different nation.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(A clan... from another country? I don't 
get it. But she's definitely picking out 
good stuff...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(In front of my king, I cannot show 
anything disgraceful. I must show 
something even better...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Um... that embroidered tunic...
choice_data_list: Isn't that a little too flashy...?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Indeed... I might have been too 
aggressive...

"Durandal couldn't choose an outfit that 
surpassed it in elegance."

And so, after spending New Year's Day with 
Fine Motion—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I see, I see... So that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
After spending the day with her, I 
understand a bit now. The reason Durandal 
can't become knightly.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. If you want to be able to compete 
gracefully, you might need to change 
something."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Something inside Durandal's heart."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: What lies within one's heart...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Um... Fine-san! What is that, and what 
should we do...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hmm, true. In order to overcome it...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Why don't you have a "duel" 
with me next time?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Not an impromptu one like today, but a 
formal duel in accordance with 
aristocratic traditions."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: An official duel, you say...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No, I won't be running in the sprint 
division, so we won't be competing 
together. So—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Through fencing♪

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Fencing... Is that swordsmanship?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Fencing is something I practice 
quite often myself."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: How about a proper rematch, then?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Are you sure about this? When it comes 
to swordsmanship, I believe I hold the 
advantage, given how seriously I have 
practiced it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Are you ready then? A fencing match?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Yes, the time and place are—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Why don't we take a short break while 
we're at it? To give both of us time to 
practice."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, a formal duel calls for a 
suitably splendid stage."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"There's a date that's just right. The 
absolute perfect day."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see. It's the day of Tracen 
Academy's traditional spring event!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The farewell party draws the attention of 
many!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ligne Droite!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The day of Droite... A noble duel, watched 
over by a multitude of students...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Princess—I accept your duel.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Before the eyes of many distinguished 
guests, please guide me in true elegance.

And so, a promise of a duel was made. The 
two Umamusume were set to clash not in a 
race, but with fencing.
